theorem.name: SmoothBNGalerkinLiftFirstModelTheorem
theorem.statement: The non-identity Heisenberg/Weyl rho_E packet admits a concrete gerbe-twisted F3^2 Fourier Galerkin scaffold with 27 modes, exact active-deck quadrature, positive Gram matrix, diagonal model stiffness, a three-dimensional zero cluster, positive complement gap, Riesz projector, and reduced Green operator. This is a numerical B_N scaffold, not yet the full selected Iwasawa/Strominger D_E basis.
